Amazing Cat Breaks Guinness World Record for Fastest Skateboarding Cat
Vroom vroom!
By
Maddie Topliff
Maddie Topliff
Maddie Topliff is the Editor, Pets of Daily Paws and The Spruce Pets. With a background in both journalism and pet ownership, Maddie expertly curates and manages content that helps pet owners provide the best for their furry and not-so-furry friends. Maddie is the proud owner of a
cockapoo
named Pickles and
American shorthair
named Jazzy.
Daily Paws' Editorial Guidelines
Published on June 13, 2024
Photo:
@guinessworldrecords / YouTube Shorts
Skateboarding is not only a hobby—it's a skill—and not a skill many humans have, let alone cats. But Bao Zi, an
American shorthair
from China, shreds like a pro and just became one of the fastest skateboarding felines in the world and holds the newest Guinness World Record for "Fastest 10 Meters On a Skateboard by a Cat." He did it in just 12.85 seconds.
In the short video, Bao Zi needs no help from his human and trainer Li Jiangtao to break the record. The one-year-old cat easily mounts the skateboard, propels himself forward, and easily coasts to victory all while his adoring fans look on. Welcome back, Tony Hawk.
Jiangtao is a very successful trainer and began skateboarding
with his dog
initially. But Bao Zi couldn't let his canine brother have all the glory and eventually mastered skateboarding as well. Bao Zi's skill set isn't limited to the skatepark—Bao Zi can also perform the following tricks:
Sitting
Shaking paws
Playing dead
Rolling over
Jumping
Climbing
Going through hoops
Pressing doorbells
Pushing rolling barrels
Dribbling a basketball
Courtesy of Guinness World Records
If you've ever felt jealous of your friends' talented dogs and their repertoire of tricks, there's no need. Cats, whether or not they have the desire to break a Guinness World Record, can also be quite
receptive to training
if they have a patient, understanding owner.
You can train your cat to perform tricks like give a high five, sit, or come
in no time
with the right attitude, and of course, the right treats. No skateboard required.
Training your cat is also a great way to
bond with your feline
, especially if they're a newer member of your household. It's also a great way to mentally stimulate your cat and prevent them from getting bored ...
or naughty
.
